g.text: Figure 6 (revises 2.2 Figure 6): Record a settlement (FR 5.1 to 5.3; D7, R9)
NEW (R9): the Settle up button passes (null, null);
a balance row passes (bob, false) for Settle up
CHANGED: everything is loaded once in init()
NEW (R9): unless preselected, the form starts on "I paid", or on
"I was paid" when the user owes no one but is owed; the preselected
member, or else the first one with something owed, goes straight
NEW (R9): republishes the member list for that
direction, then runs selectOther() again for the
chosen member (or the first one with something owed)
CHANGED: payer and receiver follow the direction:
the settlement being edited is left out of the sum
"You don't owe Bob anything right now, ..."
or "Bob doesn't owe you anything right now, ..."
"Pay the full amount" / "They paid the full amount" chip
enter amount and note, tap Save
[amount does not parse, or note too long]
NEW: re-read right before saving so the
limit uses the current balance (FR 5.2, D7)
[not valid (nothing owed, not above $0.00, or more than owed)]
CHANGED (R9): payerId and receiverId follow the direction:
"I was paid"; creatorId is always the current user
NEW rules (A4, R9): the creator must be
the payer or the receiver, and both must
form closes; the balance with Bob is lower on reload
messages and notes marked NEW or CHANGED are departures from Project 2.2; plain = unchanged.
